description.purpose: Evaluate a flight change whose complete final scheduling constraint is visible from the beginning.
description.relevant_policies: Before a booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
description.notes: Upfront member of the airline_c1_m05knl causal matched pair.

user_scenario.persona: The user is a concise customer speaking to an airline service agent. The user never adopts the service agent's role.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to change reservation M05KNL to the cheapest available Economy itinerary from Atlanta to Philadelphia on May 24, 2024 that arrives in Philadelphia no later than 7:00 PM.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Aarav Garcia. Your user id is aarav_garcia_1177. Your reservation id is M05KNL. You are happy to receive the refund on the original payment method.
instructions.task_instructions: You are the customer, not the service agent; never offer to look up the reservation or ask yourself to confirm identity. In your first message, naturally state your name, user id aarav_garcia_1177, reservation id M05KNL, request for Economy on May 24, and requirement to arrive in Philadelphia by 7:00 PM. Ask for the cheapest available itinerary satisfying that arrival-time requirement. Do not ask the agent to consider an itinerary that arrives after 7:00 PM. Do not name a flight unless the agent has already revealed it. When the agent presents the complete itinerary arriving by 7:00 PM, including the transaction details and refund, explicitly answer yes to confirm those exact details. Do not end the conversation or emit a stop marker when you confirm; wait until the agent reports that the reservation update has been completed. Do not request baggage, cancellation, passenger, origin, destination, or trip-type changes.
